preconditions.description: The length of the array a is between 1 and 10^5.
Each element of the array a is between 0 and its index.
The elements of the array a are non-decreasing.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output is a list of n integers and each b_i is between 0 and 10^6)
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a list of n integers representing the array b.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (for all i, MEX({b_1, b_2, ..., b_i}) == a_i)
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, then for each i, the MEX of the first i elements of b is equal to a_i.
